turnout.sourceTitle: 2024 County Canvass Certifications and Results - November 2024 General Election
turnout.notes: Loaded as partial county-level turnout from official Vote.Utah.gov county canvass PDFs. The extract includes 24 of 29 counties where the PDFs expose registered voters and total ballots through text extraction, audit-form totals, or precinct statistics; Davis, Duchesne, Sanpete, Uintah, and Wayne remain missing.

certifiedResults.title: Utah 2024 General Election Statewide Canvass presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are parsed from the official Utah statewide canvass PDF published by Vote.Utah.gov. The parser reconciles candidate columns to the PDF totals and records the separate total votes cast in contest.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Vote.Utah.gov 2024 election information page labels this PDF as the 2024 November General Election Statewide Canvass.

wardDetail.title: Utah county review comparison
wardDetail.detail: The official statewide canvass PDF provides county tables for President and Governor/Lieutenant Governor. The app loads county President-vs-Governor review rows; precinct or reporting-unit rows remain a future source upgrade.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Vote.Utah.gov 2024 General Election Statewide Canvass includes President and Governor county tables.

turnout.title: Utah partial county turnout
turnout.detail: County turnout is partially loaded from official Vote.Utah.gov county canvass PDFs. The app imports 24 counties where registered voters and total ballots are extractable; Davis, Duchesne, Sanpete, Uintah, and Wayne remain missing and the UI labels the coverage as partial.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Official Vote.Utah.gov county canvass page links county PDF certifications and results for the November 2024 General Election.
